Protections

No reprisal

1 (1) No employer shall dismiss a worker,

(a) for asking a question about safety; or

(b) for making a complaint,

because the worker has acted in compliance with this Act.

(2) A dismissal contrary to subsection (1) is void.

Penalties

2. A person who contravenes section 1 is liable to a fine of not more than $500,000.
